description:
Sherry FitzGerald Paul Reynolds have the pleasure in offering for sale this exceptional coastal property situated in the scenic and highly sought after area of Portsalon. It is located within walking distance of the famed Ballymastocker Beach, which has been selected amongst the top most beautiful beaches in the World. 
Portsalon is also well known for its superb golf links course and is within walking distance of the property.
Presented to the market in exceptional condition, the property offers approximately 200 sq m (2,152 sq ft) of bright, spacious and exceptionally well-appointed accommodation, with quality fixtures and fittings throughout.
The ground floor comprises a welcoming open-plan kitchen and dining area, a delightful sunroom with direct access to the paved patio, two well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom.  The family room/lounge is located in the 1st floor, thereby taking maximum advantage of the stunning views of the Bay. There are also two further bedrooms on the first floor, one of which is ensuite  together with a family shower room. 
Externally, the property is surrounded by easily maintained stone-chipped grounds and benefits from a generous paved patio area, enjoying all-day sunshine and providing the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining on long summer evenings.
Combining generous accommodation, exceptional presentation and an enviable coastal setting, this outstanding property is sure to appeal to those seeking a quality home or retreat in one of Donegal's most beautiful locations.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all this exceptional property has to offer.
